text.offer: My scouts report the orcs gather around a pit deep in the caves, where some brute rules them. Kill it, and their raids on Tos end with it.
text.progress: The pit lies past Grog's and Brog's antechambers, deep in the orc caves.
text.complete: Then the orcs are broken, for now. And now that you know those caves - I have a far more delicate errand in mind. Come and see me when you are ready.
